desc: Derive the strong-connectivity cut condition and inclusion-exclusion recurrence; simplify it to the T[y] recurrence over R[y] and identify early zero cases.
Implement and validate the O(N^2) T[y] recurrence against brute force for small N and the provided samples.
Implement the first-occurrence simplification of the recurrence and rewrite the solver as a state DP over (a_i, r_i).
Implement a fast CDQ/NTT solver for the state DP, with direct fallback for small blocks and a dense constant-offset FPS-inversion fast path.
Integrate factorial/invfactorial precomputation, R[y] computation, early exits, and output -T[N] modulo 998244353.
Validate the final solution on the public samples and small-N brute-force checks; sample tests passed.
